scope: Source/evidence feasibility only. No implementation, compiler, native solver, GPU census, candidate or performance measurement.
recommendation: Reuse the immutable D066 all-physical-row flags with a new exact accepted-plan host reconstruction. First reproduce the saved fold mapping bytes and recorded geometry, then derive a separately named planned-showdown incidence report. No second GPU census is needed for this narrowly defined sufficient whole-row predicate if those checks pass.
accepted_source: E020; all 162 source-map entries checked exact during this audit

retained_evidence.full_configs: Exact three SpotConfig objects in frozen D066 design/anchors.json; do not reconstruct from board names or a later bench_spot.json.
retained_evidence.algorithm_and_schedule: Source checks ordinary defaults: DCFR, compressed storage, isomorphism=true, no locks; two independent GpuSolver instances share immutable Spot. Every20 checks, snapshot before evaluation at20/final. No new snapshot or reweighting.
retained_evidence.native_upload_check: candidate-fold_zero_census.rs:98-130 compared complete d_rsrc[0/1], fold_nodes, node_player, node_twin and node_tlose against an independently built GpuPlan in both arms. All physical reach row lengths checked; no padding.
retained_evidence.not_native_upload_checked: show_nodes/show_spans, node_river_slot and node_ttie were not compared/downloaded by D066. Neither complete reach_slot arrays nor show mapping were retained as raw files. Their new reconstruction must be labelled host-planned; constructor source supports the upload relation, not a new device readback claim.
retained_evidence.flag_definition: One byte per entire physical row; zero means every logical f32 word is bits0x00000000. Bits1/2/4 indicate any negative zero/finite nonzero/nonfinite. It cannot classify only the board-filtered o_idx subset, recover values, prove fast-path outputs or measure time.

determinism_and_upload_proof.finding: Root hands follow ascending combo index. Tree uses exact config; suit permutations follow fixed nested enumeration, identity moved to index0. HashMaps are lookup-only for combo identity, not iteration-order producers.

Parent-before-child node IDs and action children are built serially in fixed action order; chance children enumerate card0..51. Keep root-board-only construction and all unreachable nodes: removing unused branches would renumber nodes/owners.
Parallel river calculations store by explicit stable key; each hand rank list sorts the full (strength,index) tuple. Completion order does not assign plan IDs.

Exact DFS initializes unvisited reach_src entries to owner0; action edges replace actor owner with child; chance edges replace both. Isomorphism chooses representatives from fixed valid permutation/card order. Preserve all full-tree indices, including unreachable zero-owner entries.

Work lists scan ascending node IDs into level vectors then flatten ascending levels. River slots are assigned on first node-index occurrence with HashMap entry lookup (never HashMap iteration). Physical reach slots are first owner occurrence while scanning the full reach_src vector in node-index order, separately for each player. No random seed/order affects assignments.

Payouts use exact f64-to-f32 casts from tree; plan shared geometry is untouched by full-action arena override. Compressed D066 constructors use the same build(spot,true), upload show_nodes/rsrc/river-slot/payout arrays directly and move show_spans unchanged; no later remapping.

Each nonempty show span launches one CTA per nodes[start+b], with opponent q=1-p d_rsrc/d_reach. Kernel ro_g is reach_o_buf + rsrc_o[n]*nh_o. Count every planned show node once per traverser, without deduplicating owners or counting all physical rows as show work.

snapshot_validity.proof: After the complete last paired iteration, retained reach1 is the input last consumed by p0 show: p0 up does not write reaches, and E015 p1 down passes nh1=0 and leaves reach1 intact. Retained reach0 is the last p1 show input after p1 down. Training up kernels write CFVs/learning only. Source synchronize before snapshot waits but does not replace reaches. Snapshot occurs before either exploitability call, which would replace reaches with average-policy values.
snapshot_validity.limits: This applies to those six frozen training boundaries only, not all iterations, evaluation inputs, alternate roots/continuations or arbitrary snapshots.

minimum_later_derivation: Separate root authorization is required to prepare/compile/run any exporter. Prefer one small off-tree CPU-only binary using the exact accepted solver sources without the gpu feature; include byte-exact archived plan.rs as a local module and re-export solver public game/tree/cards at crate root. Production plan.rs references only these public modules; no GpuSolver or CUDA call is needed. This integration has not been compiled here.

Pin source/Cargo.lock/toolchain and exact D066 anchors/configs; build Spot then GpuPlan::build(&spot,true), one fixture at a time. Do not construct Solver learning stores, replay training, load CUDA, or infer geometry from fold counts. The normal Spot construction still computes river tables on CPU; retain a bounded host memory/process guard.

Before new counts, require exact nodes, nh, reach_blocks and all recorded fold spans. Regenerate each entire20-byte fold record (node,slot0,slot1,selected amount0bits,amount1bits) and compare full bytes/length to all three frozen D066 fold files. This is a cross-check on deterministic reconstruction, not a substitute for the full source proof or a new device check.

Retain deterministic planned show records with node, both reach slots, river slot, f32 win/lose/tie bits and per-player sorted count; retain contiguous show level spans. Assert list coverage, unique visited terminal IDs, KIND_TERM_SHOWDOWN, valid slot/count/range bounds and exact nh/rowflag lengths. No outcomes may select a smaller fixture or omit nodes.

For each of the six snapshots and both traversers, join flags[1-p][reach_slot[1-p][node]], count whole-row +0 and separately require all three already-cast payout values finite. Report per-level and whole-show CTA counts, preserving empty sorted-own/opponent categories where present. Count launch work, not unique reach rows or hand counts; no weighted time proxy.

Write new D067 outputs with input hashes and an explicit planned mapping provenance label. Preserve D066 files/reports unchanged. Missing/mismatched geometry fails closed without GPU recensus or alternative mappings under this authorization.
minimum_runtime_claim_if_later_successfu: Planned showdown CTAs whose last training input whole row was all exact positive zero at the six retained D066 boundaries; optional separate finite-three-payout eligibility. No new GPU measurement.
limitations: No showdown incidence has been derived in this source-only audit. Published D066 counts remain fold-only.
All-row+0 is sufficient and conservative; row flags cannot reveal zeros only in the active river subset. Raw floats are unavailable.

Node_ttie and show-related device metadata have constructor/source provenance only. A requirement for independently downloaded actual show metadata would require new runtime evidence; this plan does not provide it.

Whole-row incidence does not prove a shortcut exact, remove output stores safely, bound all-iteration frequency, measure showdown latency or establish complete-cycle headroom. E035 fold rejection stays closed.
